verdict.rationale: Production deployment on Kubernetes is a fair axis for a database. The evidence covers local instances, embedded mode, Helix Cloud and CLI cluster and database management, but never mentions Kubernetes, a Helm chart or an operator. Run-mode and Cloud CLI evidence describe other deployment paths and do not count toward this story.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can deploy to production on Kubernetes with an official Helm chart or operator
